checklist.check: POST /api/v1/wallets {owner} returns 201 with wallet {id, owner, balance:0, currency}
Same key + different payload returns 409 {error:{code:'idempotency_key_reused'}} and touches nothing
Wrong method on a known route returns 405 {error:{code:'method_not_allowed'}}
All money is integer minor units; no floats touch a balance
sum(balances) == total deposited after any storm of operations
No balance goes below zero under any interleaving
Replay with same key+payload returns the original stored response; money moves once
Debit and credit commit together or not at all; single critical section (store.js, Mutex.run in applyTransfer)
Service boots and serves from a network-isolated environment with zero outbound (verified: unshare -rn, lo up)
Zero runtime dependencies — Node.js standard library only
Stage 2 UI carries the exact data-testid values from the official spec

stages.1: JSON API — every endpoint specified, with response formats and documented error codes.
stages.2: Web UI — the screens the API backs, carrying the exact data-testid attribute naming each element.
stages.3: Concurrency control — atomic check-and-act on every write path; idempotency keys returning the original response; malformed input answered with the documented error instead of a 500.
stages.4: Domain extension — a real extension of the same domain, extending the model and API already built, breaking nothing that already works.
